title: Review contract
description: Output of the Review stage. The partition, the findings, and one skeptic verdict per finding. A contract that fails this schema is a hard stop, not a warning. The next stage never runs on it.

run_id.description: The run folder under .hyperpower/runs/. null when the stage ran without a run journal.

prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the prompt that produced this contract. The orchestrator stamps it, so it is absent on the contract a stage hands to hp-validate. /hyperpower:resume reads it.

cache_key.description: Stamped by hp-journal after validation. hp-journal owns this shape, so the schema records that the field is legal and checks nothing inside it.

recorded_at.description: Stamped by hp-journal when it writes the step file, so it is absent on the contract a stage hands to hp-validate.

files_read.description: Every path this stage read. /hyperpower:resume re-hashes this list to detect drift. A file read and left out is drift the resume check cannot see.

assumptions.description: Every fact this stage relied on that it did not read in front of it. Present even when empty: an absent array reads to /hyperpower:why as zero assumptions declared. Carry an upstream assumption forward with its original id, claim and declared_at.

id.description: Unique within the run, not within the step. a1, a2.

claim.description: The fact relied on, in one sentence.

declared_at.description: The step that first declared it.

checkable.description: The file path or command that settles the claim later. null when nothing settles it, which stamps the status unresolved.

status.description: declared until the gate-time pass re-reads checkable and stamps it.

rejected.description: Options considered and dropped. /hyperpower:why --rejected reads this array by name, so it is flat and top level.

notes.description: Anything the next stage needs. Never shaped and never capped.

base_sha.description: The sha the diff is against.

slices.description: Two to six slices, cut on subsystems and seams. Never by file count.

left_out.description: Every changed file lands in exactly one slice or here. A file in neither is a partition bug.

findings.description: Ranked CONFIRMED first, then severity, then slice order. Never truncated: the cap-at-five rule applies to the rendered view, not to this array. An empty array is a valid and good answer, and means the diff is clean.

id.description: f1, f2, unique within the slice.

line.description: The anchor. A finding with no line is not a finding.

claim.description: One sentence. The defect, not the fix.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state, then the wrong output or crash.

evidence.description: file:line citations, including the blast radius.

checkable.description: For undeclared_assumption only: what settles the claim.

verdict.description: The skeptic's tier. null for a collateral finding no skeptic adjudicated. REFUTED goes to this contract only, never to the rendered report.

status.description: What the reviewer wrote. The skeptic sets verdict, not this.

trace.description: Required for CONFIRMED. One file:line per hop, entry point first.

refutation_attempted.description: What the skeptic searched for and did not find.

undecidable.description: Required for PLAUSIBLE. What the code alone cannot settle. Never for want of a reproduction.

collateral.description: Other real defects the skeptic found while reading.
